text:
jordan: Heads-up — hit a weird fallback loop in staging. Client request hits primary, times out, fallback kicks in, fallback responds, then we see a retry and fallback again. No audit entry for the fallback decision in logs. Repro-able on cluster-staging.

maya: saw this earlier too. stack trace looks like router returns 503 and client lib retries because x-retry header absent. feels like a 'phantom retry' where routing policy + client retry behavior oscillate and we never persist the decision. repro curl: 
```
curl -v -H 'x-redwood-route: prefer-low-latency' -H 'x-request-id: test-phantom-1' https://staging.redwood/api/generate
```

sam: important — audit should record the fallback decision before we send any response. otherwise playback can't reconstruct why we dropped to a cheaper model. is this a race between DecisionRecorder and ResponseWriter?

jordan: yeah recorder is async today. ResponseWriter can complete and client disconnects before recorder flushes. if recorder uses kafka and there's backpressure, events may be lost.

lena: two quick options: 1) make fallback decision emit sync minimal event (local WAL) then async replicate; 2) make recorder synchronous on critical fields (route, decision, reason) and emit rest later. tradeoffs: blocking latency vs guaranteed audit.

sam: prefer a tiny sync emit to a local write-ahead log (append-only, fsync) then background ship to kafka. minimizes latency hit and guarantees local durability for playback.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary patch for router/recorder landing window tonight 22:30 UTC if tests green :eyes:

maya: telemetry change: please add a counter fallback.retry_phantom tagged with route, model_variant, error_class. that'll let us alert on oscillation patterns and route-specific retries. also sample sample_ids (first/last request_id) in event for grouping.

jordan: +1. and include a boolean "audit_sync" flag in the event so playback can check if the minimal sync occurred.

lena: i'll draft a short design doc (1-pager) outlining Recorder.record_sync() API and the WAL shim + unit tests for race. also add e2e to simulate client retries. who can pair on tests?

sam: I'll pair tomorrow morning for the e2e. also will add a console alert: phantom_retry_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> paging (ops can tune).

jordan: filed INF-4821 and linked the minimal doc: https://redwood.internal/boards/issue/INF-4821. assign to lena. marking as ops-patch-candidate tonight if CI green :thumbsup:

lena: thanks — will push a draft in that ticket and ping everyone for review.

ops-bot: CI: tests passed on staging, canary window opened.

jordan: awesome, thanks all. let's watch fallback.retry_phantom closely after the canary and roll back if any spike.
